item.title: Wafer-scale monolithic integration of Ce:YIG films and magneto-optical isolators on silicon
item.description: arXiv:2608.09003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon integrated cerium doped yttrium iron garnet (Ce:YIG) thin films are promising candidates for integrated nonreciprocal photonic devices, cryogenic photonic modulators and optical computing applications. However, previously reported Ce:YIG thin film on silicon is limited to milimeter sizes. item.title: Valleytronics on a single chip
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01975-3 The integration of light-programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuits based on two-dimensional semiconductors has been limited by complex optical readout using bulk optics. Now, a chip integrates a metasurface with a waveguide and on-chip photodetectors to generate, sort, and read out optical valley signals in the near field, all at room temperature.

item.title: New semiconductor maser operates continuously above room temperature
item.description: Lasers have become indispensable in everyday life and research, with applications ranging from data transmission and metrology to manufacturing. Masers, by contrast, have so far found hardly any practical applications.
